title: Aceva
summary: Aceva is an AI-powered chatbot enabler platform that helps businesses automate customer engagement across multiple digital channels. Its purpose is to simplify and accelerate the adoption of conversational AI, making it accessible to organizations of all sizes without requiring technical expertise. Key Features Aceva offers a no-code chatbot builder with pre-designed templates for FAQs, lead capture, and scheduling. Businesses can deploy a single chatbot across web, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, and Telegram, ensuring consistent customer experiences. Its Natural Language Processing (NLP) engine allows the chatbot to handle free-text queries and learn from customer interactions. A live chat handoff feature ensures smooth transitions to human agents when needed. Aceva also integrates with third-party systems such as CRMs and ticketing tools, while its analytics dashboard provides visibility into customer behavior, drop-offs, and conversion trends. Benefits By automating repetitive queries, Aceva reduces response times and operational costs while enabling 24/7 support. Businesses gain the ability to capture and qualify leads instantly, improving sales efficiency. Customers benefit from immediate, personalized, and consistent interactions, leading to higher satisfaction and loyalty. For managers, Aceva’s analytics offer actionable insights into customer pain points, supporting data-driven decision-making. As companies grow, the platform easily scales to handle thousands of simultaneous interactions without requiring additional headcount. Target Audience Aceva is designed for small and medium enterprises (SMEs) seeking affordable automation, particularly in retail, F&B, and e-commerce. It also benefits service industries such as healthcare clinics, insurance providers, and property developers that need to streamline appointment booking and information requests. Customer support-heavy sectors—including telecommunications, financial services, and government agencies—can deploy Aceva to offload repetitive inquiries and free up human agents for higher-value tasks. In summary, Aceva provides an affordable, scalable, and intelligent entry point for businesses looking to embrace AI-powered customer engagement.

title: ACNEPOLIS PROPOLIS FACIAL WASH
summary: Finding a face wash that addresses acne-prone skin concerns as well as natural and sustainable skincare solutions can be challenging. Many skincare products on the market contain synthetic ingredients and potentially harsh chemicals and may not fulfill the needs of consumers seeking natural and eco-friendly products. Using harsh surfactants on the face such as sodium lauryl sulfate (SLS), ammonium lauryl sulfate (ALS) and ammonium laureth sulfate (ALES) can strip away the skin's natural oils, leading to dryness, irritation, and potentially exacerbating skin issues. Harsh surfactants can disrupt the skin barrier and cause various adverse effects, especially for individuals with sensitive or dry skin. It's essential to look for gentle and mild surfactants when choosing skincare products for maintaining healthy and balanced skin. Developing a mild face wash that offers effective solutions for acne-prone skin as well as for various skin types and concerns, all while adhering to sustainable and ethical sourcing practices, presents an opportunity.

title: ADVANCED AUTOMATIC TERMINAL INFORMATION SERVICE
summary: ATIS stands for Automatic Terminal Information Service. It is a service provided by air traffic control (ATC) at airports to disseminate current weather information and other essential data to pilots. ATIS broadcasts are pre-recorded messages that are continuously played on a specific radio frequency or through a data link system. The purpose of ATIS is to provide pilots with up-to-date information about the current weather conditions, runway in use, instrument approach procedures, and other important details relevant to the safe operation of aircraft at the airport. By listening to or receiving ATIS broadcasts, pilots can gather crucial information before they contact the ATC for further instructions.

title: Advanced Positive Negative Pressure Isolation Pod: MyISOPOD™
summary: The COVID-19 pandemic and other infectious disease outbreaks have highlighted the need for effective isolation methods to prevent the spread of contagious pathogens in medical and public health settings. Traditional isolation methods often lack the necessary negative pressure control and portability required for optimal patient care and containment of infectious agents. The Advanced Negative Pressure Isolation Pod by Puncak Bumi Utama Sdn Bhd is designed to provide a portable, secure, and highly effective isolation environment for patients with infectious diseases. The pod uses advanced negative pressure technology to contain airborne pathogens, preventing their spread to healthcare workers and other patients. Its compact, lightweight design allows for easy transportation and deployment in various settings, including hospitals, emergency response situations, and quarantine facilities. The Advanced Negative Pressure Isolation Pod from Puncak Bumi Utama Sdn Bhd offers several key benefits that make it an ideal choice for effective infection control. With a load capacity of 150kg, it accommodates a wide range of patients while maintaining a lightweight design at just 18kg, ensuring easy transport and deployment. The pod is powered by a battery that lasts up to 8 hours on a single charge, making it suitable for prolonged use in various settings. It features HEPA filters to effectively capture airborne pathogens, an alarm system for low power and battery alerts, and performs 15 air exchanges per hour to maintain a clean and safe environment for both patients and healthcare workers.

title: AEROS AI Reverse Osmosis Water Treatment System for Hemodialysis
summary: The reverse osmosis (RO) water purification system comprises of a RO system complete with RO module that produce pure water on site and channels reverse osmosis water directly to all dialysis stations via the PEX tubing c/w S/steel shackle clip and quick release connector. The Reverse Osmosis water purification system incorporates a new design concept to maximize water usage without compromising on its quality. Typically, raw water conductivity in Malaysia is ≤ 150μs and to drain away water after a single pass through the RO membrane is wasteful. Pretreatment system consisting of 2 raw water pump c/w digital pressure control for auto start/stop features. Standby raw water pump will enter run mode if the pump on duty tripped and notification will display on the RO screen. Sediment filter, Carbon filter and Water softener are all built in series connection after each pretreatment column will have a panel mount pressure gauge install in front of the system for easy viewing c/w sampling valve for ease of water sampling. Water softener controller will have a detection switch to shut down RO System during dialysis to avoid high salt contact with RO Water from entering HD Machine. Our system design tank with several capacity whereby operating pressure of Raw Water > 70 psi, Flow Velocity > 1.5 Feet Per Second was based on Jabatan Bekalan Air supply which is of WHO drinking standard. This proposed tank size is to match the RO Capacity. A reject recirculation system is installed in the RO system to recover reject water. (SAVE WATER) The function of the recirculation system is to recover reject water from the RO membrane and channel back to mix with the pre-treatment water inline so as to reduce and avoid bio burden. A special clamp, developed by JKS BIOMEDICAL Sdn Bhd, on the PEX Tubing at the pure water distribution loop maintains the smooth internal surface of the PEX tubing by eliminating/minimizing the use of joints hence minimizing bio film formation. JKS BIOMEDICAL has pioneered the development of hygienic sampling port for water sampling. This is to avoid contamination or false biological assay during water sampling. Soft start and variable speed feature of the RO booster pump enables optimum system pressure is maintained to the RO membrane as well as reducing energy consumption. This system employs 2/3/4 units of several RO membrane to produce ≥ 10 liters or more RO water to cater for 10 or more units of hemodialysis treatment machine. In addition, with JKS Biomedical’s new RO system i.e. Advance Economical Reverse Osmosis System (AEROS) which make use of an inverter, we are able to produce RO water depending on the demand.

Image-Guided Training Integration supports the use of real fluoroscopic or ultrasound guidance, enabling clinicians to develop essential skills such as needle placement, contrast injection, and joint visualization. This interactive training environment improves clinical decision-making and procedural proficiency. The use of real needle sets identical to those employed in arthrogram procedures further enhances training authenticity. Trainees gain valuable hands-on experience while familiarizing themselves with procedural techniques in a risk-free environment, reducing learning curves and enhancing patient safety in clinical practice. In summary, Arthro Shoulder bridges the gap between theoretical learning and clinical application by offering a comprehensive, lifelike simulation environment tailored to shoulder arthrogram procedures. Its patient-specific design, tactile realism, and integration with real procedural tools ensure a superior training experience for clinicians and trainees alike.

title: Biodegradable Products
summary: The purpose of creating biodegradable drinking straws made from broken rice and tapioca is to offer an eco-friendly alternative to traditional plastic straws that addresses the environmental concerns associated with plastic waste. These straws are designed to serve the same functional purpose as plastic straws while significantly reducing the negative impact on the environment. Here's a brief description of their purpose: The biodegradable drinking straws made from broken rice and tapioca are crafted from natural, renewable materials. Broken rice, which is a byproduct of rice processing, and tapioca, derived from cassava plants, are combined to create a sturdy and flexible material suitable for drinking straws. The primary purpose of these straws is to provide a sustainable alternative to single-use plastic straws that often contribute to pollution, marine litter, and environmental degradation. Key purposes of these biodegradable straws include: Reducing Plastic Pollution: The straws are intended to reduce the reliance on conventional plastic straws, which take hundreds of years to degrade and often end up in landfills and oceans, harming marine life and ecosystems. Minimizing Resource Depletion: By using broken rice and tapioca, which are agricultural byproducts, the straws aim to utilize materials that would otherwise go to waste, contributing to more efficient resource utilization. Biodegradability: The straws are designed to break down naturally over time, returning to the environment without causing long-lasting harm. This contrasts with plastic straws that persist in the environment for extended periods. Promoting Sustainable Practices: The production of these straws encourages sustainable agricultural practices, as they utilize rice byproducts and cassava plants that can be grown in a more environmentally friendly manner. Educating and Raising Awareness: The use of innovative, biodegradable materials raises awareness about the environmental impact of single-use plastics. It encourages individuals, businesses, and industries to consider more sustainable alternatives. Offering a Viable Solution: The straws provide a practical and functional solution for consumers, restaurants, and beverage providers who seek environmentally responsible choices without compromising on usability. Supporting Circular Economy: These straws contribute to a circular economy model by utilizing agricultural waste to create useful products, reducing the need for virgin resources. Catering to Consumer Demand: As consumer demand for eco-friendly products grows, these straws cater to individuals who want to make environmentally conscious choices in their daily lives. In summary, the purpose of biodegradable drinking straws made from broken rice and tapioca is to provide an accessible, sustainable, and functional alternative to plastic straws. By addressing the problems associated with plastic waste, these straws contribute to a cleaner environment and promote a more responsible approach to consumption and waste management.

title: BlackFusion- supplement for health improvement
summary: This solution supports Malaysia’s goal to strengthen preventive healthcare and early detection by offering a natural, science-backed approach to reducing cardiovascular disease (CVD) risks. The product targets key modifiable risk factors, including high cholesterol, inflammation, and lifestyle-related fatigue — all of which contribute to poor quality of life and increased disease burden. The core of this solution is a functional supplement combining honey and Nigella sativa (black seed), both known for their antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and lipid-lowering properties. The formulation leverages thermal processing techniques aligned with Malaysian Standards (MS) for honey, and applies controlled roasting at optimum temperatures for black seed to preserve bioactive compounds like thymoquinone and phenolics. Key features include: - Honey dehydration to meet moisture and HMF standards (MS2683 & MS2679), - Roasting of black seed under optimal thermal conditions to activate anti-inflammatory compounds, - 1:1 blend of honey and ground roasted black seed to ensure full-spectrum synergy. The solution offers multiple benefits: - Reduces total and LDL cholesterol, - Improves energy levels and mental alertness, - Alleviates inflammation, benefiting those with fatigue, sinusitis, or autoimmune-linked conditions, - Supports gut and metabolic health, aligning with holistic preventive care goals. Target audience includes adults with borderline or elevated cholesterol, individuals experiencing lethargy, working professionals under chronic stress, and communities at risk of non-communicable diseases (NCDs). It is also suitable for those seeking natural alternatives to support long-term health. By integrating traditional wisdom with validated processing technology, this solution exemplifies preventive innovation grounded in Malaysian bioresources.

title: BLICUT Spine Simulator
summary: The BLICUT Spine Simulator is an advanced training platform designed to enhance clinical proficiency in minimally invasive spine procedures. Featuring replaceable 3D-printed bones, anatomically accurate structures, and a human-like casing, it provides a realistic environment for practicing essential skills such as puncture site identification, angiographic-guided insertion, and treatment planning. This comprehensive setup enables clinicians to experience lifelike tactile feedback while developing critical procedural accuracy. The simulator’s replaceable 3D bones replicate true bone density and anatomical landmarks, allowing repeated practice without wear and tear. Intervertebral discs are precisely modeled to simulate complex spinal procedures like vertebroplasty, kyphoplasty, and spinal fusion, offering real-time practice for device navigation, catheter insertion, and implant placement. Angiographic-guided insertion training enables clinicians to gain hands-on experience with fluoroscopy-guided procedures, improving their spatial awareness, accuracy, and decision-making during minimally invasive spine surgeries. The human-like casing ensures an authentic procedural environment, reinforcing hand-eye coordination, instrument handling, and anatomical recognition. The BLICUT Spine Simulator also supports treatment planning for spinal interventions, helping clinicians visualize and rehearse complex procedures before performing them on actual patients. This reduces procedural risks, enhances surgical confidence, and improves clinical outcomes through safe, hands-on learning. In summary, the BLICUT Spine Simulator bridges the gap between theoretical learning and real-life clinical practice by offering lifelike anatomical accuracy, replaceable components, and interactive procedure simulation tailored to minimally invasive spine procedures. Its unique design empowers clinicians to master essential skills, refine techniques, and improve patient safety in a realistic, controlled environment.

title: Blockchaincert.my
summary: Our state-of-the-art digital certification platform harnesses the power of blockchain technology to revolutionize the issuance, management, and verification of certifications. Designed to serve educational institutions, professional bodies, and organizations, the platform ensures that every certificate issued is immutable, secure, and easily verifiable. At its core, the platform leverages blockchain's decentralized ledger to create tamper-proof records of certifications. Once issued, each certificate is cryptographically signed and recorded on the blockchain, providing an unalterable and transparent record. This not only eliminates the risk of fraud but also simplifies the verification process for employers, academic institutions, and other stakeholders. The platform supports a wide range of digital certificates, including diplomas, professional licenses, and achievement badges. Users can easily share their certifications via secure links or QR codes, allowing instant verification by third parties. The platform’s user-friendly interface makes it simple for organizations to issue certificates and for recipients to manage their credentials. In addition to its robust security features, the platform integrates with existing systems via APIs, ensuring seamless adoption. The use of blockchain also guarantees long-term availability and accessibility, as records are distributed across multiple nodes, making them resilient to loss or corruption. This digital certification platform sets a new standard for trust and security in credential management, offering a future-proof solution that meets the demands of the digital age.

The service is ideal for oil palm plantation owners, management firms, and agribusinesses across Malaysia seeking to modernize and optimize their replanting strategies. Unreacted material and by-products are recycled back into the process. Additionally, it generates less hazardous sludge compared to other coagulants. Applications: - Water Treatment: Effective for municipal and industrial water purification. - Wastewater Treatment: Suitable for treating various types of wastewater. - Food and Beverage Industry: Safe for use in processes requiring stringent clarification standards. - Temperature Variability: Functions effectively in both high and low-temperature environments. Benefits: - Cost Efficiency: Reduced need for pH adjustment, lowers overall treatment costs. - Environmental Impact: Less hazardous sludge production and recycling of by-products contribute to sustainable practices. - Health Safety: Minimal residual aluminium ensures safer treated water with fewer health risks. Based on our case study for Selangor Saring Program, Selangor Saring is carried out across the state based on the government’s early screening, diagnosis and treatment policy. Increased Participation: Digital methods led to 81,415 screenings conducted with 27,428 registrations recorded, boasting a strong 67% attendance rate, which is among the highest in the country.​ 4. summary: PROBLEM STATEMENTS: Major drawbacks related to the use of commercial interior paint have been identified based on market surveys and users' feedback. The main issues associated with the current commercial product are: i. Not user-friendly in terms of cost of paint and operation, such as on the needs to use thinner as solvent. ii. Low hiding power and low opacity. Hence, multiple layers need to be applied to cover the old surface. iii. Odorous smell, toxic, irritation, and some are corrosive. iv. High Volatile Organic Content (VOC) that is risky to the user when freshly applied in a confined space. v. High heavy metal content such as mercury, cadmium, and lead. vi. 60% of non-renewable petroleum-based polymers such as acrylic and polyurethane were used in interior paint as a binder. The solutions that we are offering and commercializing promote the use of a “green platform technology” as a binder which produced from bio-based resources (natural latex) to partly replace the petroleum/ acrylic-based binder widely used in conventional paint. On top of using it for paint, the “green” binder can also be used in many other applications, leaving us with a lot of future opportunities, for new, green product development and market penetrations. Advantageously, the present innovation provides natural paint with great properties, such as highly durable wet scrub abrasion, water resistance, nontoxic, low odors, low metal content, low VOC, and anti-fungus resistance. This innovation is able to reduce atmospheric pollution and enhance the quality of life due to less use of volatile solvents. The innovation also utilizes natural rubber latex as a mixture of binders (rubber latex + acrylic), which not only offer products of better properties but also meet the requirement of Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) for it to be classified as 'green' product. With 30% of its composition comprising natural latex, it has become a better alternative as compared to general oil-based paint, where its four (4) main components i.e. pigment, binder, liquid and additives are all petroleum-based; which cause potential health hazard as well as environment concerns. Our Unique Selling Propositions (USP): i. Environmentally friendly paint because it used cellulose-based thickener and is highly compatible with other ingredients. The common thickener used in paint is polyurethane and clay. ii. Enhanced the quality of life by reducing the use of petroleum-based chemicals, hence reducing atmospheric pollution and carbon dioxide emission. iii. Proven by experimental approach to be non-toxic, low VOC, low odor, and undetectable heavy metal content - The higher component of petroleum-based solvent used in the composition, the higher the VOCs and heavy metal content in it. As our solution use water as solvent, it would be a great choice for health and the environment. iv. As it is a water-based paint, it is easier for users to wash after use. v. Double layers are sufficient to cover the old surface due to its high opacity. vi. Applicable on various types of surfaces i.e., concrete, gypsum, wood, soft board, ceiling, and Cornish for building, construction, and mural painting. vii. Safer and greener interior paint product. viii. Low-cost of production. ix. Can be applied with confidence without using water. x. Comply with Green Building lndex (GBl) to reduce the impact on human health and the environment. The products have been researched, developed, and tested both in the lab and in the actual environment (residential, shop lots, petrol station, etc.) - Please refer to our pitch deck and supporting documents for more information.

title: Femoral Access Training Intervention (FATIn)
summary: FATIn (Femoral Access Training Intervention) is a portable, anatomically accurate femoral access simulator designed for ultrasound-guided training in vascular access procedures. Its non-complicated design features a replaceable puncture site, enabling repeated practice while maintaining cost-efficiency. The model includes realistic femoral anatomical structures, such as the femoral bone, femoral artery, and femoral vein, ensuring lifelike tactile feedback and visual accuracy during procedures. The simulator supports ultrasound-guided femoral access management, offering a mobile femoral casing for use in various training environments, including classrooms, clinical workshops, and field simulations. Its real-time ultrasound compatibility enables trainees to practice locating and accessing vascular structures, performing needle insertion, and advancing catheters under ultrasound guidance. Replaceable Puncture Sites allow for repetitive use while ensuring hygienic and effective training. This feature minimizes downtime and maintenance costs, making FATIN ideal for high-volume training programs. Its compact, mobile design eliminates the need for extensive setup, allowing on-the-go training sessions and easy transport. FATIN addresses critical challenges in clinical training, including skill development gaps in vascular access procedures, limited access to advanced simulators, and the need for portable, cost-effective solutions. It enhances procedural confidence while reducing learning curves, enabling trainees to gain essential skills in a realistic, risk-free environment. In summary, FATIn is a highly portable, ultrasound-compatible femoral access training solution, offering anatomical accuracy, realistic tactile feedback, and cost-effective replaceable components. It empowers clinicians to build procedural expertise, ensuring safe and accurate femoral access management.

title: GoCrete EcoTerrazzo Circular Innovation
summary: GoCrete — Circular Concrete Innovation for Sustainable Smart-City Surfaces GoCrete is a premium Malaysian-made material innovation that transforms 100 % post-consumer and post-industrial glass waste into high-performance architectural products. Developed through local R&D by Naturaall Glass Solutions, this proprietary low-carbon formulation substitutes virgin silica with recycled glass sand and aggregate, yielding terrazzo-like finishes that are both durable and design-forward. Demonstrated in a relevant industrial environment (TRL 6), GoCrete offers high compressive strength, and UV- and burn-resistant surfaces suitable for basins, countertops, pavers, and façade panels. Each piece is hand-cast with up to 70 % recycled content, meeting ESG and low-VOC standards while diverting glass from landfills and reducing embodied CO₂ by up to 70 %. Aligned with the Advanced Materials and Smart Cities & Transportation drivers of MySTIE 10-10, GoCrete supports Malaysia’s transition toward circular construction by enabling sustainable infrastructure, adaptive reuse of waste streams, and scalable local manufacturing of eco-engineered materials for green buildings and urban design applications.

title: Goswiet PLUS Tunjuk Langit Softgel
summary: Goswiet Tunjuk Langit Plus Softgel is an R&D product developed using green Supercritical Fluid Extraction (SFE) technology over nearly seven years by Universiti Teknologi Malaysia (UTM), Skudai. It is certified by the National Pharmaceutical Regulatory Agency (NPRA) and holds Halal certification from the Department of Islamic Development Malaysia (JAKIM). The extraction process yields essential oils and oleoresins. The resulting essential oil contains Omega 6, 9, and B-sitosterol, which can help control blood sugar levels and assist in accelerating skin cell wound healing.

Hasil ekstrak daripada proses perahan akhir menghasilkan minyak pati dan oleoresin. Minyak pati yang dihasilkan tersebut mempunyai kandungan Omega 6,9 dan B-sitosterol yang mampu mengawal paras gula dalam darah. Ia juga boleh membantu mempercepatkan proses penyembuhan luka untuk sel kulit.

title: GuardExpert Pro (GEP)
summary: With the availability of IoT technology, the utilization of smartphone for remote access and device control is made possible and becomes more common nowadays. One potential deployment of a smartphone control system is in a guard touring system (GTS). A conventional GTS lacks features such as real-time data upload, multiple functions on one device and is not competitively priced. We have conducted market validation with our clients and we plan to introduce new features for the current GTS. Currently, the client is facing difficulties to monitor and integrate all sites and sites simultaneously. Besides that, current GTS is time consuming and difficult to supervise. Lastly, for sites that have unstable internet connections, the patrolling cannot be conducted and the reporting cannot be stored into the cloud server. Therefore, our smart GTS has been introduced and the system consists of a mobile device with built-in Near Field Communication (NFC) and Radio Frequency Identification (RFID), an Android application for real-time interaction, a cloud database management system and NFC tags installed at designated checkpoints. The application will be designed to provide user-interface for audio, image capture, Global Positioning System (GPS) based wireless tracking of guard’s patrolling activities and reporting feature. Therefore, in this project, the development of a smart GTS that provides audio and image communication, cloud database management and Global Positioning System (GPS) technology is proposed. The smartphone will be used as the medium for collecting data while patrolling and reporting. A web browser will also be designed for easy and user-friendly access. The system performance will be investigated in terms of network delay and GPS accuracy to guarantee it is within acceptable time limit and distance limit. The value proposition is able to enhance premises safety and security, integrity reporting, reduce administration workload, and fast and precise response to alert.

title: HeritEdge: AI Robot Presenter (Where Culture Meets Tech)
summary: HeritEdge is an AI Robot Presenter powered by LISA (Learn Intelligently Support Assistant) that functions as a cultural storyteller that digitalizes cultural assets (either tangible or intangible assets and legacies) in a way that resonates with a modern, global audience. Similar to Beyond Heritage and Tanoti, LISA archives indigenous stories and traditions by creating interactive digital archives that promote cultural exchanges globally. LISA’s core features include text/video-to-video conversion, seamless translation, and interactive engagement. By translating and creating multilingual content and using AI to add personalized vocalizations, we make cultural assets accessible to broader audience. Our tools support NGOs, cultural organizations, and tourism boards in digitalizing heritage information, enabling them to reach new markets and maintain cultural richness for future generations.

title: Hi-Profeed feather meal
summary: Animal farming is crucial to the global food supply, making animal feeds essential. In Malaysia, chickens are the top meat source, producing significant waste. Bio Metro Fusion addresses this by converting byproducts into high-protein, digestible animal feed, helping reduce environmental pollution. With Malaysia importing RM7.8 billion worth of animal feed ingredients, our product stands out for its price, availability, and versatility for local feed millers. Bio Metro Fusion was established on May 9, 1996, by Mr. Yeo Liek Seng and Mr. Yeo Liek Kiang, with a paid-up capital of RM1,850,000. We operate in a 2-acre building on 4 acres of land in Bukit Pasir, Muar, Johor. Since 2012, we have focused on R&D to develop a cost-effective alternative protein for the animal feed industry. We have invested over RM10 million in setting up our facility and conducting R&D and business activities. Our technology focuses on converting non-digestible poultry feathers into high-crude, highly digestible animal feed protein. We break down the thought keratin molecules into digestible proteins using machinery and methods without chemicals, resulting in pure feather meal protein. The process will be further enhanced by reducing the moisture content below 5% to prevent bacteria growth and prolong the shelf life. Key highlights of Bio Metro Fusion’s project include: • Local technology for high crude and high digestibility protein. • The most affordable digestible crude protein in the market. • Achieved 99% protein digestibility for Tilapia using in vitro test conducted by MARDI • 2 patents and 1 trademark involved in this project. • Support and recognition from government agencies. • Collaboration with MARDI and the Fishery Research Institute. • Achieved pioneer status in 2017.

title: High Value Crystalline Nanocellulose (CNC) from Oil Palm Empty Fruit Bunches (EFB)
summary: NanoQuartz Sdn Bhd’s collaboration with University Malaysia Pahang are crafting an environmental success story by transforming Malaysia's palm oil waste into Crystalline Nanocellulose (CNC). Utilizing Empty Fruit Bunches (EFB), we have turned an annual environmental challenge into a valuable resource. CNC emerges as a versatile hero in the materials realm, boasting qualities like high tensile strength, biodegradability, and adaptability across industries. This innovation aligns seamlessly with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Acting as a trailblazer, CNC supports SDG 7 and SDG 9 by offering a clean energy alternative and fostering innovation. Beyond profitability, this quest contributes to sustainable urban development (SDG 11) and climate action (SDG 13). NanoQuartz's commitment to ESG principles fortifies the collaboration, aligning with SDG 17 and establishing a sustainable innovation model. In this exciting opportunity, Malaysia's waste management challenges become catalysts for economic growth and environmental sustainability. NanoQuartz is not just storyteller; we are architects of a legacy where cellulose-based advanced materials spearhead Malaysia's industrial growth. It's a compelling tale of circular economy magic, transforming waste into a hero for a sustainable future.

title: HippoScan
summary: HippoScan is an advanced moisture measurement system using neutron backscatter techniques. It is portable, non-intrusive, and does not require the removal of insulation before measurement. HippoScan can identify the presence of moisture within insulation. It can be used on various process components and pipes, specifically detecting moisture inside insulation. It quickly identifies wet insulation that may lead to corrosion and failure of process components and pipes, particularly corrosion under insulation.
summary_original: HippoScan merupakan satu sistem pengukuran kelembapan termaju dengan menggunakan teknik serak balik neutron. HippoScan adalah mudah alih, tidak mengganggu operasi dan tidak perlu menanggalkan mana-mana bahagian penebat sebelum pengukuran dilakukan. Hipposcan mampu mengenal pasti kehadiran kelembapan dalam penebat. Boleh digunakan pada pelbagai komponen proses dan paip serta bertindak balas khusus mengesan kelembapan di dalam penebat. Ianya cepat untuk mengenal pasti penebat basah yang mungkin mengakibatkan kakisan dan kegagalan komponen proses dan paip terutamanya karat di bawah penebat.

title: HMagSys - Hospital Management System

Built to support both clinical and administrative workflows, HMagSys seamlessly handles patient registration, clinical documentation, inpatient and outpatient management, diagnostics, pharmacy, ward transfers, discharge processes, and billing—all in one system. It also offers powerful back-office capabilities such as inventory tracking and staff management. With integrated features like electronic medical records (EMR), appointment scheduling, lab and radiology modules, and automated notifications, HMagSys enables hospitals of any size to operate more efficiently, reduce manual workload, and deliver safer, more coordinated care. Whether for general hospitals, specialist centers, or multi-facility healthcare networks, HMagSys provides the flexibility and depth required to support modern, end-to-end hospital management.

title: Hybrid Acoustic Technology System (HATs)
summary: The Hybrid Acoustic Technology System (HATs) introduces an innovative approach to non-destructive testing (NDT) by integrating high-performance wave guides and adaptive sensor attachment systems specifically engineered for extreme-temperature and non-metallic environments in the Oil & Gas sector. The solution addresses critical industry pain points such as unreliable acoustic data in high- temperature conditions and limited inspection capabilities on non-metallic structures by enabling accurate, real-time, and non-intrusive monitoring without operational shutdowns. The high-performance wave guides are designed to maintain acoustic signal integrity in extreme environments, ensuring precise anomaly detection and structural integrity assessment. Meanwhile, the adaptive sensor attachment system allows for secure and effective application of sensors on non-metallic surfaces such as Glass Reinforced Epoxy (GRE), broadening the applicability of acoustic emission testing across diverse materials. Key benefits include enhanced safety through early anomaly detection, minimized downtime, and improved inspection reliability. HATs significantly reduces maintenance costs and environmental impact by supporting continuous online monitoring and eliminating the need for intrusive testing methods. The target audience includes Oil & Gas operators, petrochemical facilities, and industries that rely on high-integrity infrastructure in challenging environments, particularly where extreme temperatures and material diversity limit conventional inspection technologies.

title: Increase ion calcium released in drinking water.
summary: Hijrah Water is commercializing calcium hydroxyapatite derived from fish scales which is unique technology, promoting waste to wealth resources. Usage of calcium ball in our water filtration system added the value of the drinking water to become mineralised, alkalined and contained high calcium. Hydroxyapatite is a natural form of calcium phosphate, the main mineral in bones and teeth. Supplementing with this form of calcium may enhance bone density and strength, especially in those at risk for osteoporosis. Microcrystalline hydroxyapatite can support enamel repair and reduce sensitivity by filling in microscopic holes in enamel. . It is often used in dental care and could offer oral health benefits if consumed regularly in low doses. High Bioavailability Calcium from hydroxyapatite is more readily absorbed compared to some other calcium salts (like calcium carbonate). The presence of phosphorus in a biologically relevant ratio (Ca:P ~1.67) also supports effective calcium utilization in the body. Natural and Sustainable Source Fish-scale-derived hydroxyapatite is a sustainable byproduct of the seafood industry, offering an eco-friendly alternative to mined calcium sources. Potential Anti-inflammatory and Antioxidant Effects Some studies suggest that trace proteins or peptides associated with fish-derived HAp might have anti-inflammatory or antioxidant effects. Supports Muscle and Nerve Function Calcium is critical for neuromuscular signaling and muscle contraction, so improving dietary calcium intake can aid in preventing cramps and muscle weakness.

title: INSPECTO-D
summary: Product Overview: INSPECTO-D is a duct inspection cleaning robot which aims to inspect and clean Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) system of a building. HVAC duct are the main air distribution for indoor environment. Modern HVAC duct is normally hidden inside the ceiling thus it is hard to visualize the duct structures. The importance of inspection & cleaning the HVAC duct routinely is often neglected by the building management and public. A dirty HVAC duct may possess threat to human because as the dust accumulates it trap harmful airborne particles and even diseases that can cause Sick Building Syndrome. A schedule inspection and maintenance are required to maintain optimum indoor air quality (IAQ). Although the inspection and maintenance works are usually conducted by human, it requires a specialist where large area need to be covered which require numerous manpower and time to completed the task. In this regard, robotic solutions have been implemented in many cases. INSPECTO-D is a multi function robot that has a modular design where it can mount a brush, air nozzle, lidar, pan tilt zoom camera or a laser scanner, whichever suits the need of customer. INSPECTO-D with additional laser scanner can inspect and digitalize the duct pathway so the cleaning process can later be automated. With the optional accessories of brush & air nozzle attached, INSPECTO-D can be transformed into a cleaning robot and adapt to different duct size and cleans it. Product Feature: 1) Modular Design - fast swap between inspection and cleaning function 2) Easy to Use - Plug and Play operation 3) Multi camera view with adjustable camera 4) Sensors for edge detection Product Benefits: 1) Enhanced Safety 2) Improved Operational Efficiency 3) Real time data and reporting 4) Long term reliability 5) Suitable to local duct size Target Customer: 1) Healthcare facility management operators 2) Government building operators 3) Industrial building operators 4) Building maintenance contractor : - Office - Factory - Shopping mall

title: Integrated Methyl Esters Blending System using Hydrodynamic Cavitation (IMeBS)
summary: Methyl ester is a key component for various materials, including as a solvent for Emulsifiable Concentrate (EC) in insecticide production. Using methyl esters from plants like rubber seed oil reduces production costs, adds value to products, and lowers risks associated with synthetic chemicals. IMeBS produces methyl esters with short reaction times, with an optimal production rate of 30 L/unit for better economic quality assurance and environmental friendliness. This prototype has the potential for large-scale commercial production with industry collaboration. Product quality meets ASTM D6751 and EN 14214 standards. Compared to existing technology, this innovation reduces the acid value of raw oil and increases the purity of methyl esters using mixed raw oils with high saturated acid values.
summary_original: Metil ester ialah komponen utama untuk pelbagai bahan termasuk sebagai pelarut bagi Emulsifiable Concentrate (EC) untuk penghasilan racun serangga. Penggunaan metil ester dari tumbuhan seperti minyak biji getah akan menurunkan kos penghasilan, menambah nilai produk dan mengurangkan risiko disebabkan kimia sintetik. IMeBS menghasilkan metil ester dalam masa tindak balas yang pendek, dengan keadaan optimum kadar penghasilan adalah 30 L/unit untuk jaminan kualiti ekonomi yang lebih baik dan mesra alam sekitar. Prototaip ini mempunyai potensi untuk dihasilkan dalam skala besar sehingga mencapai taraf komersial dengan sokongan dan kerjasama industri. Kualiti produk memenuhi standard American Society for Testing and Materials (ASTM) D6751 dan EN 14214. Berbanding dengan teknologi sedia ada, inovasi ini mampu mengurangkan nilai asid minyak bahan mentah dan meningkatkan ketulenan metil ester yang menggunakan minyak bahan mentah campuran dengan nilai asid tepu yang tinggi.

title: iPoultry
summary: After interviewing several small and medium scale farmers, we had determined that the following is the need of the market: No tracking or visibility of Poultry Environment: There is limited to no easy tracking of vital bird house environment parameters. Currently prevalent systems are deployed in-house & track only Temperature & Relative Humidity. The farmer has not real-time visibility of this data, unless he goes inside the farm and checks the data. Incident Management: Farmers are unable to react in time to avert accidents or loss of chicken in case of emergencies as information is not available real-time and there is no alert mechanism. For example: Ammonia is a very vital parameter, and it indicates the health and good grown of chicken. Exposure to high levels of Ammonia for longer periods of time affect the bird’s respiratory apparatus and this in turn hampers the growth of the bird. A timely alert in the middle of the night will help the farmer avert this danger in time. Bird Weight Tracking: Tracking of the bird’s weight is a difficult task and is often performed by the farm workers. The farm workers often pick the biggest of birds to measure the weight, out of fear of reprimand by the farmer. This does not give the farmer a true picture until it is too late. There are bird weight tracking systems available however they are not integrated as part of a comprehensive system and only work in isolation. Farmers will greatly benefit from an integrated platform where they can track the weight, feed & other parameters which is most likely to provide key insights, as regular data comes in. Variance in Weight of Chicken: Farmers state that the weight of the chicken, based on which they get paid, is varying for each batch, despite the inputs such as feed, medicine, labour costs etc remaining the same. They are unable to determine the reasons behind the same. Chick weighing at harvest: while loading is quite laborious and often error prone with farmers having to measure and aggregate their weight of 10,000 chicks and no place to store or track this information. Difficulty with Labour: Labour is difficult to come by and even more difficult to retain. Often times in the region, labour is also undocumented. This causes troubles for both the farmer and labour. Poultry House monitoring is a 24/7 job and the farmers today have to employ 3 to 4 people to man their barns. This is significantly adding to the operational costs of the farmer, particular in volatile times when feed prices see a steep increase.

title: Logic Patient Specific Implant
summary: We believe the traditional methods employed by hospitals before and during surgeries have significant limitations. These methods often rely on restricted 2D data for analysis, lack simulation capabilities for preoperative planning, and depend on in-situ decision-making rather than detailed preparation. Through 3D Gens, we provide advanced solutions to overcome these challenges. title: MARDISENSE RICE DISEASES SENSOR KIT: ANTIBODY-MODIFIED SCREEN-PRINTED ELECTRODES FOR RICE DISEASES DETECTION
summary: The purpose of this developed biosensor is for the early detection of three major rice diseases in Malaysia (i.e., bacterial leaf blight - BLB, bacterial leaf streak-BLS and blast diseases) to prevent loss of yield due to pathogen infections. This biosensor comprised of two components: (i) a handheld /portable electrochemical biosensor reader that will eventually be innovative on-site rice disease detection tool prior to the appearance of any visual symptoms so that corrective measures can be taken to prevent the spread of disease; and (ii) biosensor strip (i.e. screen-printed carbon electrode). The functionalized SPCEs showed good selectivity and sensitivity due to detection as low as 10^2 CFU/mL and 10^3 conidia/mL for P.oryzae. Modification of screen-printed carbon electrodes (SPCEs) was achieved via electrodeposition of functionalized multi-walled carbon nanotubes (MWCNTs) and polypyrole (Ppy) networks on the surface, followed by antibody immobilization. The labelled antibody (i.e. antibody-HRP) is required in the sandwich type assay format in the functionalized SPCE for the indirect detection of targeted rice diseases’ agents. The binding interaction between the enzyme and its substrate will generate an electrochemical signal, and this signal (in uA unit) will be displayed, measured, and recorded. The data collected by the reader will be stored on a dedicated web server, whereby the authority agencies can access this data for further real-time monitoring. Eventually, in the long run, the data collected could be gathered and analysed to form location-mapping or trend-mapping of the disease's spread and occurrence. Furthermore, it is cost-effective and efficient. Our target audience are in agricultural sectors

title: MasChain
summary: MasChain is a purpose-built Layer-1 blockchain that lets government agencies and regulated enterprises in Malaysia and Southeast Asia embrace public-chain benefits without running into the usual roadblocks. Low, predictable transaction fees remove budgetary hurdles, and on-chain privacy options keep sensitive information within national borders. Its biggest accelerator is a plug-and-play middleware layer—complete with REST APIs, SDKs and familiar tooling—that abstracts away node management, wallet handling and smart-contract complexity. Because the interface looks and feels like standard web development, roughly 95 % of existing software engineers can start building blockchain applications immediately, slashing both learning curves and time-to-market. In short, MasChain meets the trust, compliance and data-integrity requirements of highly regulated institutions while transforming almost any developer into a capable blockchain builder, unlocking new efficiencies and use cases across the public and private sectors.

Now, the app can be used by both healthcare volunteers and healthcare professionals to provide accessible screening services to patients, anywhere. Within the app, users take a photo of an oral cavity, and an integrated AI component analyses the quality of the photos and informs the user if the image is of sufficient clarity for remote reading, or if the quality is insufficient and needs to be retaken. Patients can then submit their images and will receive feedback from dentists or dental specialists, along with a referral recommendation, if applicable, when there is a lesion at risk of becoming oral cancer. This allows screening for oral lesions to be done at a larger scale and increases access to early detection for our communities regardless of whether they live in urban or rural areas. The MeMoSA® Workbench platform allows exportable real-time analytics of comprehensive data on screening performance and case updates for healthcare providers. The upcoming MeMoSA® app update is set to incorporate another AI algorithm capable of automatically classifying oral lesions based on images taken through the app, further enhancing its diagnostic capabilities for use as a decision support tool by healthcare professionals.

title: MIMOS Microinverter EVT2000
summary: Microinverter Technology: Solution Summary Microinverter technology involves small inverters installed on each individual solar panel to convert direct current (DC) into alternating current (AC). Unlike traditional string inverters that handle the entire solar array, microinverters work independently at the panel level. Key Benefits: Maximized Energy Output: Each microinverter uses Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) independently, optimizing power from every panel. This reduces losses caused by shading, dirt, or panel mismatch, increasing overall system efficiency by up to 25%. Improved Reliability: Since panels operate independently, a fault in one microinverter or panel does not affect the entire system, reducing downtime. Enhanced Safety: Microinverters operate at lower voltages, minimizing electrical hazards like arcs, making installation and maintenance safer. Flexible Design & Monitoring: They enable flexible system layouts and easy expansion. Panel-level monitoring provides detailed performance data, simplifying troubleshooting and maintenance. Simplified Installation: Reduced wiring complexity and low-voltage operation can lower installation time and costs.

title: MK2200L Combined Overcurrent and Earth Fault Relay
summary: The MK2200L is a multifunction numerical relay designed for reliable overcurrent and earth fault protection in three-phase electrical systems. summary: The MyGreens™ Reverse Vending Machine (RVM) is an innovative, tech-driven solution aimed at addressing the environmental and regulatory challenges of Waste Cooking Oil (WCO) disposal in Malaysia. For the government and corporations, it supports ESG commitments and compliance with the International Sustainability & Carbon Certification (ISCC). For users, it offers incentives through digital platforms, encouraging responsible disposal behaviors. The primary target audience includes food businesses such as restaurants and hawker centers, local councils, waste management companies, biodiesel manufacturers, and environmentally conscious households. By fostering collaboration across these groups, MyGreens™ RVM represents a scalable, future-ready solution that contributes to a cleaner environment and a circular economy.

The system supports multi-level training, accommodating beginners learning respiratory basics and advanced practitioners performing complex procedures like extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO). summary: BRIEF TECHNOLOGY Peritocare provides an innovative solution with a portable peritoneal dialysis system designed to offer freedom and improve patients’ quality of life. This machine is lightweight, easy to carry, and equipped with Internet of Things (IoT) technology, allowing data to be monitored in real-time by hospitals. This not only simplifies treatment management for patients but also reduces the risk of infection with its user-friendly design INSPIRATION OF THE INVENTION The inspiration for Peritocare came from the need to improve the quality of life for chronic kidney disease patients, who often face restrictions due to traditional dialysis methods. PROBLEM STATEMENT & CURRENT ISSUES Traditional peritoneal dialysis presents significant challenges for chronic kidney disease patients, primarily due to the restrictions it imposes on their mobility and independence. Patients are often tied to a machine for several hours each day, disrupting their daily lives and limiting their ability to work, engage in social activities, and maintain a normal routine. This inconvenience is compounded by the high risk of infection, such as peritonitis, which requires strict hygiene protocols that can be difficult to maintain consistently. Additionally, patients in rural or remote areas face accessibility challenges, making it harder for them to receive regular treatment. As the number of CKD patients continues to rise, these issues also place an increasing burden on healthcare facilities, making it difficult to provide adequate care for everyone in need.

title: ProDetect® Dengue NS1 Antigen Rapid Test
summary: ProDetect® Dengue NS1 Antigen Rapid Test is a rapid immunochromatographic test for the visual screening of dengue NS1 antigen in human whole blood, serum or plasma as an aid in the diagnosis of dengue infection. For in vitro and professional use only. Dengue fever, also known as breakbone fever, is an infectious tropical disease caused by the dengue virus. Dengue viruses, transmitted by the Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes are widely distributed throughout the tropical and sub-tropical areas of the world. There are four known distinct serotypes (dengue virus 1, 2, 3 and 4). In children, infection is subclinical or causes a self-limiting febrile disease. However, if the patient is infected a second time with a different serotype, a more severe disease, dengue hemorrhagic fever or dengue shock syndrome, is more likely to occur. Dengue is considered to be the most important arthropod-borne viral disease due to the human morbidity and mortality it causes. NS1 is a highly conserved glycoprotein that is present at high concentrations in sera of dengue-infected patients during the early clinical phase of disease. NS1 antigen is found on the first day and up to 9 days after onset of illness in cases of primary or secondary dengue infected patients. ProDetect® Dengue NS1 Antigen Rapid Test utilizes dengue NS1 antigen for dengue diagnosis. Hospitals & Clinics, Diagnostic Laboratories, Research Institutions

title: ProDetect® hCG Pregnancy Rapid Test
summary: ProDetect® hCG Pregnancy Rapid Test is a rapid pregnancy test. It detects the presence of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG), which appears in urine during early pregnancy. The egg is normally fertilized by a sperm cell in the fallopian tube. Within 9 days the fertilized egg moves down the fallopian tube into the uterus and then it attaches (implants) to the wall of the uterus. After the fertilized egg implants, the growing placenta starts releasing hCG into your blood. Some hCG also gets passed in your urine. HCG can be found in the blood before the first missed menstrual period. This can be as early as 6 days after the egg implants. HCG helps to keep your pregnancy going. It also affects the development of the baby (fetus). Levels of hCG go up fast in the first 14 to 16 weeks after the last menstrual period. They are the highest around the 14th week following the last period, after which they go down gradually. The level of hCG early in the pregnancy can give information about the pregnancy and the health of the baby. Soon after delivery, hCG can no longer be found in the blood. title: Pulmonary Embolism Simulator (PEsim)
summary: Pulmonary Embolism Simulator (PEsim) is a specialized training platform designed for endovascular procedures related to pulmonary embolism management. It focuses on developing clinical expertise in treating lung-related vascular blockages through advanced catheter-based interventions. The simulator features a multimodality material design, enabling realistic simulations of various tissue responses, vessel elasticity, and dynamic blood flow. This allows clinicians to practice catheter navigation, clot retrieval, thrombolysis, and stent deployment with lifelike feedback, closely replicating real-life pulmonary embolism procedures. PEsim supports multi-level training for both beginners and advanced practitioners. New learners can master essential skills such as catheter handling and guidewire control, while experienced clinicians can rehearse complex interventions. Customizable training scenarios enable tailored learning experiences based on clinical needs, patient-specific anatomy, or specific institutional protocols. In summary, PEsim is a versatile, high-fidelity training tool designed for pulmonary embolism interventions, offering a unique combination of multimodality material technology, realistic anatomical modeling, and scalable training features. Its specialized design improves clinical proficiency, enhances patient safety, and supports advanced skill development for life-saving pulmonary embolism treatments.

title: Real-Time Mobile Navigation Map for Military Vehicles (MILINAV)
summary: MILINAV is a real-time mobile navigation system engineered specifically for military vehicles of the Malaysian Armed Forces. The solution addresses critical operational gaps not met by commercial navigation tools by providing seamless display and navigation using local topographic maps generated by the Department of Survey and Mapping Malaysia (JUPEM), including L7030, T738, MY701T, and MY711T series. Designed for convoy operations, reconnaissance, and special operations units , MILINAV operates on a ruggedized tablet compliant with US Military Standard MIL-STD-810H, ensuring reliability in harsh environments. The system functions completely offline by utilizing pre-loaded, encrypted map data, making it ideal for missions in network-denied areas. Key features include multi-coordinate system support (including GDM2000 and Grid Reference) , an integrated gyroscope for vehicle roll and pitch monitoring , a tactical compass , and a comprehensive data logger for after-action reviews. By integrating local map data with mission-critical tools, MILINAV significantly enhances situational awareness and operational effectiveness on the battlefield.

title: Regrooving & Recoating Technologies on Polyurethane (PU)
summary: The Wire Guide Roller (WGR) is a critical component in wire saw technology used for slicing silicon into wafers in the wafer fabrication industry. The regrooving and recoating process is essential to maintain the long-term durability and effectiveness of the WGR, as the grooves wear down over time. This introduced regrooving and recoating technology utilizes automated PU, cutting tools, and computer numerical control (CNC) machines to control strength levels up to 2 microns. This helps produce cleaner products and more precise cuts.
summary_original: Wire Guide Roller (WGR) ialah bahagian utama teknologi gergaji dawai untuk menghiris silikon untuk menjadi wafer silikon dalam industri fabrikasi wafer. Proses mengaras dan menyalut semula adalah perlu untuk mengekalkan ketahanan bagi jangka masa panjang dan keberkesanan WGR kerana alur akan haus dari semasa ke semasa. Teknologi mengaras dan menyalut semula yang diperkenalkan ini adalah menggunakan PU automatik, alat pemotong dan mesin kawalan berangka komputer (CNC) untuk mengawal tahap kekuatan sehingga 2 mikron. Ini akan membantu menghasilkan produk yang lebih kemas dan pemotongan yang lebih tepat.

title: REHLA daily UV Defence SPF 50
summary: Saudi Arabia has a desert climate, with hot, dry summers in the interior. This differs significantly from the hot, humid tropical climate of Malaysia. Malaysian pilgrims often experience skin issues such as dryness, cracked heels from walking on marble floors treated with antibacterial solutions, and skin irritation, which can affect their focus during worship. REHLA is a wellness product line for Malaysian pilgrims designed to address these issues. We are enhancing our formulations using Nanovesicles™ technology for rapid moisture absorption with gelam leaf extract, and Fishield™ technology from marine extracts for efficient protection against UVB radiation. These technologies are patented by UMT and are at TRL8. We are developing new formulations incorporating these technologies, along with hydroxyapatite from sardine bones and organic moisturizing agents like hyaluronic acid, alpha-arbutin, and niacinamide, to ensure effectiveness.
summary_original: Arab Saudi merupakan sebuah negara beriklim padang pasir, kecuali bahagian barat daya negara itu, yang mempamerkan iklim separa gersang. Musim panas di kawasan tengah sangat panas dan kering, antara 27°C hingga 43°C di kawasan pedalaman dan 27°C hingga 38°C di kawasan pantai. Dalam erti kata lain, iklim Arab Saudi sangat berbeza dan agak lampu berbanding dengan iklim tropika panas dan lembab sepanjang tahun di Malaysia. Jemaah umrah dan haji Malaysia akan mengalami masalah kulit kering, tumit merekah akibat berjalan di atas lantai marmar yang telah diletakkan larutan khas antibakteria yang agak tinggi dosnya bagi yang tidak sesuai, gatal-gatal di peha dan leher serta di tangan yang akhirnya agak menggugat kekusyukan kita beribadah kepada Allah di kedua-dua kota suci Mekah dan Madinah. REHLA merupakan produk penjagaan kesejahteraan muka dan badan oleh Jemaah umrah dan haji di Malaysia dan penggunaanya mampu mengatasi masalah yang disebutkan di atas. Permasalahan besar, mereka memerlukan formulasi yang lebih hebat untuk mengupayakan lagi jualan dan keyakinan terhadap produk ini. Pemasalahan formulasi akan kami pertingkatkan dengan teknologi Nanovesicles™ yang berupaya menghasilkan penyerapan kelembapan yang cepat dengan ekstrak daun gelam serta teknologi Fishield™ daripada ekstrak marin yang berupaya memberikan penjagaan terhadap cahaya terik matahari atau radiasi UVB dengan efisyen. Teknologi ini tidak perlu dimulakan dengan kajian awal kerana kedua-duanya telah selesai sepenunya (berada pada TRL8) serta berjaya dipatenkan oleh UMT dengan MyIPO. Kami akan menyediakan formulasi-formulasi baharu di atas iaitu formulasi pelembab tinggi beraskan ekstrak daun gelam serta ekstrak hidroksiapatait yang telah diperbaharui (daripada tulang ikan tamban) serta penambahan ejen pelembap organik (hyloronik asid, alpha-arbutin, niacinamide etc) lain dan akan membuat beberapa pengesahan ujian untuk memastikan keberkesanan. Kedua-dua teknologi ini juga merupakan inovasi bahan bio yang sangat mapan dan mampu melonjak penjualan syarikat serta mengekalkan teknologi secara berterusan demi kelestarian alam.

title: RX1000 (COMBINED OVERCURRENT & EARTH FAULT RELAY)
summary: The RX1000 is a state-of-the-art combined overcurrent and earth fault protection relay designed for safeguarding electrical systems against faults and abnormal conditions. It ensures the reliable and efficient operation of electrical networks by promptly detecting and isolating fault conditions. Key Features: Comprehensive Protection Functions: 1. Overcurrent Protection: Three-phase, three-stage setting with selectable time delay types (Definite Time (DT), Inverse Definite Minimum Time (IDMT)). 2. Earth Fault Protection: Two-stage setting with adjustable time delays and threshold values. 3. Thermal Overload Protection: Provides protection against overheating, ensuring equipment longevity. 4. Cold Load Pickup and Circuit Breaker Failure Protection: Ensures system stability during load fluctuations and breaker operations. Advanced Monitoring and Diagnostics: 1. Real-time System Monitoring: Continuous tracking of system conditions to detect anomalies promptly. 2. Built-in Self-Test and Soft Recovery Watchdog: Enhances system reliability by performing regular diagnostics and recovery processes. 3. Internal Relay Failure (IRF) Alarm: Alerts operators to system abnormalities, enabling quick intervention. User-Friendly Interface and Programmability: 1. NFC Communication: Allows for easy reading and setting of parameters via MikroNFC app (compatible with Android and iOS). 2. Programmable Settings: Customizable protection thresholds and time delays to suit specific operational requirements. 3. Time-Stamped Event Recording: Logs up to 120 events, including power failures and setting changes, for comprehensive fault analysis. High Reliability and Standards Compliance: 1. IEC 60255 Compliant: Adheres to international standards for electrical relays. 2. Environmental Tolerance: Operates reliably in a wide temperature range (-10°C to 55°C) and high humidity conditions (5% to 95% non-condensing). 3. Durable Output Contacts: Rated for high voltage (250VAC) and capable of enduring extensive electrical (10^5 operations) and mechanical (5 x 10^6 operations) cycles. Seamless Integration: 1. Flexible Installation: Designed for panel mounting with IP54 protection at the panel and IP20 at the body. 2. Programmable LEDs and Contact Outputs: Allows for easy integration with existing alarm and control systems. Benefits: 1. Enhanced System Safety: Minimizes damages to equipment and reduces downtime by quickly isolating faults. 2. Operational Flexibility: Customizable settings provide tailored protection solutions for various applications. 3. Ease of Use: Simplified interface and programming reduces the learning curve and operational errors. 4. Integration and Compatibility: Advanced communication features ensure compatibility with existing and future systems. Target Audience: The RX1000 is ideal for utility companies, industrial plants, and large commercial facilities seeking robust protection for their electrical system. It caters to engineers and technical personnel responsible for maintaining the reliability and safety of electrical infrastructure.

title: RX232 Earth Fault Relay
summary: The RX232 Earth Fault Relay by Mikro is a reliable and advanced protection system for electrical systems. It features NFC communication for parameter settings and monitoring via the MikroNFC app on Android and iOS. The relay supports two-stage earth fault settings with selectable time delays and protections, recording up to 120 events and 30 faults with timestamp logs. It provides both fundamental and true RMS measurements, with selectable frequencies and a circuit breaker failure protection feature. The relay also offers flexible output contacts for system alarms and abnormalities, with an Internal Relay Failure (IRF) alarm. It adheres to IEC 60255 standards and has robust operational tolerances and IP54 and IP20 enclosure protection ratings.

title: RX233 Overcurrent Relay
summary: The RX233 Overcurrent Relay is a mobile app-based overcurrent relay designed to enhance protection and monitoring for electrical systems. It features NFC capability, real-time monitoring, self-test and recovery, event logging, three-phase overcurrent protection, frequency settings, and configurable output contacts. The relay also supports 50 or 60 Hz frequency options and is standard compliant with IEC 60255 and ANSI codes. Its technical specifications include a current rating of 5A with a frequency of 50 or 60Hz, an accuracy of ±3%, adjustable overcurrent and thermal overload, and output contacts with a rated voltage of 250VAC. The relay operates within -10°C to 55°C, 5% to 95% humidity, and is panel mountable with IP54 protection. It is ideal for applications requiring robust overcurrent and fault protection in industrial electrical systems. The relay is designed for use in various environmental conditions.

title: RX300 Earth Leakage Relay
summary: The RX300 Earth Leakage Relay is a comprehensive solution for detecting earth leakage currents in electrical systems. It offers real-time monitoring, precise fault detection, and seamless protection. The relay features adjustable earth leakage thresholds and customizable time delays, allowing for flexible configurations in various operational environments. It also includes a self-reclosing feature to restore power after transient faults, minimizing downtime. The relay also features built-in self-test, soft recovery, and fail-safe mechanisms, and an Internal Relay Failure (IRF) alarm for early warning. The user-friendly interface with NFC technology simplifies configuration and monitoring. The relay meets IEC 60255 standards and is suitable for harsh industrial environments. With an operating temperature range of -10°C to 55°C, IP54 enclosure protection, and resistance to high humidity, it is suitable for harsh industrial environments. The RX300 is a state-of-the-art solution in electrical protection systems.

title: Sayajual.io
summary: SayaJual is a Malaysian-developed multichannel ecommerce platform that empowers individual sellers, small businesses, and sales agents to grow their digital presence effortlessly. It offers a simple, no-code solution to generate customizable landing pages for products, complete with integrated order management, payment gateways, and delivery tracking. The platform acts as a centralized hub for managing digital sales activities across various channels. Sellers can create product-specific pages and share them through social media, messaging apps, or agent networks. Agents can be onboarded easily and tracked for performance, enabling commission-based selling and affiliate-style distribution without the need for complex systems. SayaJual also supports catalogs, testimonials, and promotional content blocks, making it suitable for a wide range of products and services. It is especially beneficial for sellers who want to establish an online sales funnel quickly without relying on large marketplaces or expensive custom websites. Planned enhancements include AI-powered tools to automate landing page creation and content generation based on user input. This will further reduce the time and effort needed to launch and manage product campaigns online. By streamlining the selling process, SayaJual contributes to the digitalization of local commerce and helps more Malaysians participate in the digital economy — whether as business owners, part-time agents, or digital entrepreneurs.

Boleh menggantikan anggota badan yang dipotong.

title: Schinkels Pharmacy Refrigerator with IoT-Enabled Monitoring for Cold Chain Compliance: SMR-1015L
summary: The Schinkels Pharmacy Refrigerator is specially engineered to provide a stable and secure environment for storing temperature-sensitive pharmaceuticals, vaccines, and medical products. Designed to meet international healthcare standards such as WHO guidelines and Good Distribution Practices (GDP), it ensures that critical medicines are stored within the optimal temperature range of +2°C to +8°C at all times. Key features of the Schinkels Pharmacy Refrigerator include a high-precision digital temperature controller, built-in data logger, and a multi-alarm system that alerts users to temperature deviations, power failures, or door ajar incidents. Selected models come with OMTAS (Online Monitoring Triggered Alarm System), an IoT-enabled solution that offers real-time monitoring, historical data access, and instant notifications via web or mobile. User-friendly components such as adjustable shelves, internal LED lighting, and lockable doors ensure convenience, organization, and security. The benefits of using the Schinkels Pharmacy Refrigerator include reliable temperature control to preserve product efficacy, reduced risk of financial loss due to spoilage, and easy compliance with regulatory requirements. With robust performance and energy-efficient operation, it also supports green initiatives and lowers long-term operational costs. The target audience includes public and private hospitals, health clinics, retail pharmacies, research laboratories, and vaccination centers across Malaysia and beyond. Schinkels Pharmacy Refrigerator is ideal for healthcare providers who demand precision, reliability, and compliance in pharmaceutical storage.

title: SIMPLE (Simplified Medical Platform for Emergency)
summary: According to the National Audit Report 2018, the Emergency & Trauma Department (ETD) unable to perform its function efficiently due to increased volume of patients with limited logistics. The report also indicates that 42 to 36% of all patients received treatment in the emergency department could not be admitted within stipulated time of 4 to 6 hours. And many ETDs are unable to meet the KPI of ambulance response time within 15 minutes for Priority One Cases. Since the efficiency of ETD's delivery is vital in reducing mortality and disability rates, R&D&C in improving its delivery efficiency is of paramount importance. Thus, the development of SIMPLE (Simplified Medical Platform for Emergency), which include: a) the development of data dictionary for emergency registry and records b) observational study on ambulance response time c) observational study on type of event activation d) Geo-location mapping on the timing and type of event activation Based on the data collected from the activities above, strategic deployment of ambulance based on geospatial-event-time analysis can be performed to optimise the ETD's limited resources in managing emergency and trauma cases. In addition to this, based on the integration of SIMPLE and cHEART; a Personal Health Information app, the impact of having early and fast access to patient's medical records through cHEART will also be documented to improve the quality of care.

title: Smart Road Asset Management System (SRAMS)
summary: A Smart Road Asset Management System is a technology-driven solution designed to monitor, maintain, and manage road infrastructure efficiently. It combines IoT sensors, GIS mapping, drones, AI, and data analytics to provide real-time insights into the condition and usage of road assets such as pavements, signs, guardrails, bridges, and lighting systems. The system collects data using dashcam and drone video footage. Dashcams is installed in moving vehicles continuously capture high-resolution road surface videos, while drones conduct aerial inspections, offering a wider and more flexible view of the network. The footage is uploaded to a central platform, where AI-based computer vision algorithms automatically analyze each frame to detect and classify damage such as potholes, cracks, and rutting. Additionally, each vehicle is equipped with a GPS tracker to track its real-time location and ensure proper route coverage during inspections. The system also integrates with social media platforms such as Twitter (now X), allowing citizens to submit complaints or posts about road damage, which can be linked directly into the asset management system. Based on all collected and processed data, SRAMS can automatically generate reports containing detailed information such as road names, dates of data collection, and types of road conditions. All findings are visualized on a centralized GIS dashboard, giving road authorities a live overview of asset conditions and helping prioritize maintenance tasks based on severity, location, and community feedback. This end-to-end automation reduces manual inspections, improves data accuracy, and enhances the efficiency of road maintenance operations.

title: Stream Full Vacuum System
summary: A Stream Full Vacuum System (FVS) which is one of the technology in Automated Waste Collection System (AWCS) is a modern and efficient method of waste management that uses advanced technology to collect, transport, and process waste with minimal human intervention. AWCS systems are designed to address the challenges of traditional waste collection methods by improving efficiency, reducing environmental impact, and enhancing cleanliness in urban and commercial areas as well as hospitals and transport hubs such as airports. Key Components of AWCS: 1. Waste Collection Points: These are strategically located in residential, commercial, or public areas where users deposit their waste. Collection points can include smart bins, chutes, or loading stations that are often designed to automatically sort or compact waste. 2. Pneumatic Systems: Waste is transported from the collection points to a central processing facility through underground waste pipeline with the use of pneumatic systems, air pressure is used to move waste quickly and efficiently. 3. Centralized Processing Facility: All the waste collected through the system is directed to a central facility where it can be sorted, compacted, recycled, or processed for energy recovery. This facility handles various types of waste, including solid waste, recyclables, and organic material. 4. Control and Monitoring System: AWCS is managed by a central control system that monitors waste levels, system performance, and collection schedules. The system uses data analytics and IoT (Internet of Things) sensors to optimize operations in real-time.

title: Synthetic Antibody Production via in Silico Conformational Aptamer Development by Design (ICADD)
summary: In Silico Conformational Aptamer Development by Design (ICADD) is a novel method for producing synthetic antibodies or aptamers tailored to specific molecular affinities. These aptamers are suitable for various detection assays and are currently licensed for commercial use via aptasensors. Advantages of ICADD include: custom-designed antibody-like molecules, animal-free production, guaranteed affinity and specificity, rapid design and in silico testing, cost and time efficiency compared to conventional methods, lack of batch variation, stability at room and high temperatures, suitability for toxin detection, and therapeutic potential.
summary_original: Antibodi sintetik atau aptamer adalah kaedah baharu untuk mendapatkan antibodi yang sesuai. In Silico Conformational Aptamer Development by Design (ICADD) dapat menghasilkan aptamer atau antibodi sintetik mengikut keperluan affiniti molekul yang disasarkan. Aptamer yang dihasilkan sesuai digunakan dalam pelbagai ujian pengesanan dan kini telah dilesenkan untuk kegunaan komersial melalui aplikasi aptasensor. Antara kelebihan ICADD adalah: i. Molekul yang berfungsi seperti antibodi yang direka khas; ii. Tidak menggunakan haiwan; iii. Antibodi sintetik dijamin afiniti dan khusus; iv. Antibodi sintetik boleh direka dalam masa singkat dan diuji secara “in silico” untuk tahap afiniti; v. Menjimatkan masa dan kos berbanding penghasilan antibodi secara konvensional; vi. Tiada variasi kumpulan; vii. Stabil dalam suhu bilik dan suhu tinggi; viii. Antibodi sintetik boleh direka untuk pengesanan toksin; dan ix. Mempunyai keupayaan terapeutik.
