title: Urbankit
summary: Urbankit has been developed by MARDI to provide an opportunity for the urban B40 community to reduce household expenditures while increasing revenue for community projects. The objective of this project is to help 100 participants of B40 community to generate side income and reduce household expenses. This kit is suitable for the cultivation of herbs, vegetables and freshwater fish farming. Suitability of vegetables such as peppermint (herb), salad, spinach, okra, brinjal, kale coelomic, tomato and chilli have been tested with this system. For freshwater fish, Jade Perch species has been chosen due to its tolerant to water conditions such as pH, temperature, oxygen, nitrate and the market price is very competitive. Urbankit is developed as a proof of concept and as a Do-It-Yourself (DIY) kit. The kit measures 5½ feet in length and 2 feet in width and can be used indoors and outdoors. The design kit uses aluminium and polybox which are strong, lightweight, durable and anti-rust. This kit is portable and can be moved from one place to another as well as tailored to the customer needs. This system has proven to be successful in fulfilling nutrient requirements of vegetables and fish. The waste from fish rearing and excess food (pellets) from the pond containing ammonia (NH3) is pumped into the bio-filter. The bio-filter function produces good bacteria such as Nitrosomonas sp. to decompose ammonia into nitrite. The resulting nitrite is decomposed by the bacteria Nitrobacter sp. to nitrate. The root of vegetables absorbs nitrites and nitrates for growth. Finally, clean nutritive fresh water nutrient filtered by plant roots flows back into the pond and the process is repeated. The kit has proven to fulfil the concept of green technology as its produce is organic and does not require chemical fertilizers and pesticides. The results of the experiment indicated a water pH of 7.57, ammonia 0.02 ppm, nitrite and nitrate 6.16 ppm and 20.54 ppm. The water quality results values which are within the tolerance limits and not harmful for fish, vegetables and herbs growth. These findings support the research by Dina,S [1997] said that the organic manure has the added advantage of providing more healthy vegetables for human consumption and ensuring optimum soil fertility for sustainable production.
institute: Malaysian Agricultural Research And Development Institute (MARDI)

summary: A Visitor Management System (ViMS) is a digital platform designed to streamline and secure the process of handling visitors within an organization or facility. Alerts and notifications automatically inform hosts when their guests arrive and notify security if unauthorized access is attempted. The system can also integrate with other security systems such as surveillance cameras and access control mechanisms for added layers of safety. Benefits of a VMS include enhanced security, as it helps prevent unauthorized access and provides accurate visitor data. Additionally, it helps maintain a professional and modern image, offering a seamless and well-organized visitor experience. The target audience includes corporate offices, educational institutions, healthcare facilities, government buildings, and event venues where managing high volumes of visitors is critical for both security and operational efficiency. title: VL JEJAK: Smart Integrated Solid Waste Management System
summary: VL JEJAK is an AI-driven, cloud-based smart waste monitoring system developed to address the inefficiencies and challenges faced by solid waste contractors and local councils in Malaysia. With waste collection and public cleansing services largely privatized, many contractors struggle to ensure consistent work quality, especially in the absence of direct supervision. This often results in public dissatisfaction, contractor penalties, and reputational damage to municipal councils. VL JEJAK offers a comprehensive digital solution consisting of a mobile application and a centralized dashboard designed to monitor and track two key components: waste collection services (PPS) and public cleansing operations (KPA). Unlike traditional manual reporting via WhatsApp, VL JEJAK automates job scheduling, report generation, and real-time progress tracking accessible to both contractors and the public. The system utilizes deep learning technology powered by Jetson Nano, with real-time video feeds and RFID sensors mounted on garbage trucks to verify bin collection, assess bin condition, monitor SOP compliance by workers, and detect leachate spills. These insights are processed and uploaded to the cloud for analytics and real-time decision-making. VL JEJAK is already partially adopted by Majlis Bandaraya Seberang Perai (MBSP) under the brand name i-Collect MBSP and is being commercialized through Visionlytics Sdn Bhd under a B2B subscription model. The system is protected by two registered copyrights and one filed patent, making it a scalable and proprietary solution to transform municipal solid waste management in Malaysia.

title: X10 Earth Leakage Relay
summary: The Mikro X10 is a smart, reliable solution for comprehensive earth leakage protection in modern electrical systems. Designed for industrial, commercial, and utility applications, the X10 combines advanced detection technology with flexible control features to enhance system safety, operational uptime, and regulatory compliance. With its dual protection groups, the X10 allows users to set different leakage sensitivity and time delay settings for separate zones within the same system, providing tailored protection where it’s needed most. Its real-time LCD display and RS-485 Modbus-RTU communication enable seamless monitoring and integration with building management systems, ensuring constant visibility and fast response. In short, the X10 delivers high-performance leakage protection, remote monitoring capability, and user-friendly operation—making it a reliable choice for critical electrical safety requirements.

title: X20 Earth Fault Relay
summary: The Mikro X20 Earth Fault Relay is a compact, reliable solution for detecting earth faults in electrical systems. It offers both definite-time and selectable IDMT curve protection, ensuring accurate fault detection and easy coordination. With dual setting groups, users can quickly switch configurations for different operating conditions. The X20 features event logging with timestamps for fast, accurate fault analysis and RS‑485 Modbus-RTU for seamless integration with SCADA or monitoring systems. Built-in harmonic blocking and inrush detection reduce nuisance tripping, ensuring stable operation. Compliant with IEC 60255 standards and designed for easy installation, the X20 delivers advanced protection in a user-friendly, cost-effective package.

title: X30 Combined Overcurrent & Earth Fault Relay
summary: The X30 Combined Overcurrent and Earth Fault Relay is a sophisticated numerical protection relay designed to deliver reliable and intelligent protection for electrical systems. Suitable for both three-phase three-wire and four-wire configurations, it consolidates multiple protection functions into a single, compact unit. This makes it an ideal solution for modern industrial, commercial, and utility power networks where space, efficiency, and performance are critical. At its core, the X30 provides robust protection against phase overcurrent, earth faults, and thermal overloads. It features programmable inverse definite minimum time (IDMT) curves, including NI, VI, EI, and LTI, to suit various system requirements. Additional capabilities include trip circuit supervision, circuit breaker failure protection, and thermal overload monitoring. The relay also supports RS485 MODBUS-RTU communication, enabling seamless integration with SCADA systems and remote monitoring platforms. The X30 is equipped with four programmable digital inputs and four output contacts, allowing flexible configuration for diverse applications. Its LCD interface offers intuitive navigation, while its event, fault, and alarm logging, up to 250 timestamped records, supports proactive diagnostics and maintenance. The device complies with international standards including IEC 60255 for protection relays, as well as IEC 61000-6-2 and IEC 61000-6-4 for electromagnetic compatibility, ensuring reliable performance even in electrically noisy environments. Designed for electrical engineers, facility managers, and system integrators, the X30 serves as a dependable solution for safeguarding critical infrastructure. Its compact design, advanced protection features, and standards compliance make it a strong candidate for MySTI certification and a valuable asset in any high-demand power distribution setting.

title: X60 Combined Overcurrent & Earth Fault Relay
summary: The X60 is a compact, multifunction combined Overcurrent & Earth Fault relay designed to detect, record and quickly isolate phase and earth-faults to protect distribution feeders and downstream equipment from damage and nuisance trips. Key features include a numerical protection core with 2×16-digit LCD, three-phase with three-stage phase overcurrent and two-stage earth-fault protection (IDMT and definite-time curves), thermal-overload protection, trip-circuit supervision and circuit-breaker-failure logic. It offers RS232/RS485 MODBUS-RTU communications, event/fault timestamps, programmable digital inputs/outputs and full compliance to IEC 60255 plus common ANSI codes (49RMS, 50P, 50N, 51P, 51N, 50BF, 74TC, CLP). It is compatible with Mikro’s Mikrosafe software for settings, monitoring and logs. Benefits: fast, selective fault clearing that reduces asset damage and downtime; flexible protection coordination with multi-stage settings; easier commissioning and remote monitoring via MODBUS and Mikrosafe; and clear forensic data (event/fault logs) to speed troubleshooting and maintenance. The relay’s programmable I/O and compact footprint simplify retrofits into existing panels. Target audiences: electrical engineers and protection coordinators, OEMs and panel builders, facility and plant maintenance teams, and utilities or contractors needing a cost-effective feeder protection relay with modern communications and logging for medium-voltage distribution and industrial applications.

title: Zero Waste Management System
summary: Improper solid and food waste management can cause foul odors and attract pests like flies, cockroaches, and rats, which may lead to the spread of dangerous diseases. The Zero Waste Management System (ZEWMAS) solves this by converting food waste into plant boosters and organic fertilizer, reducing the use of chemical fertilizers that contribute to the greenhouse effect. The organic fertilizer produced is known as MOZA Organic Fertilizer, while the plant booster is named Booster IKBN Pekan (BIP). MOZA organic fertilizer is produced from fuel, microbes, and goat manure, and can neutralize soil pH. It contains 12 types of nutrients that improve plant immunity and is 99.9% pathogen-free. Research shows that after 14 months of using MOZA organic fertilizer, soil fertility increases and fertilization requirements can be reduced by 60%.
summary_original: Pengurusan sisa pepejal dan makanan yang tidak sempurna boleh mendatangkan bau busuk dan mengundang kehadiran binatang perosak seperti lalat, lipas dan tikus yang boleh mengakibatkan penularan wabak penyakit berbahaya. Zero Waste Management System (ZEWMAS) dapat menyelesaikan masalah ini kerana ZEWMAS menukarkan sisa makanan kepada plant booster dan baja organik serta mampu mengurangkan penggunaan baja kimia yang menyumbang kepada kesan rumah hijau. Baja organik yang terhasil daripada ZEWMAS ini dikenali sebagai baja Organik MOZA, manakala plant booster pula dinamakan sebagai Booster IKBN Pekan (BIP). Baja organik MOZA dihasilkan daripada bahan bakar, mikrob dan tinja kambing serta boleh meneutralkan pH tanah. Baja organik ini mengandungi 12 jenis nutrien yang dapat meningkatkan sistem imunisasi tanaman dan 99.9% bebas patogen. Berdasarkan kajian, penggunaan baja organik MOZA selama 14 bulan, tanah menjadi sangat subur dan pembajaan dapat dikurangkan sebanyak 60%.
